distractors.reason: We win prizes, races, or games, not tests. 'Win a test' is not natural English.
We lose games, points, or money, not tests. 'Lose a test' is not used for taking an exam.
We break rules, records, or promises, not tests. 'Break a test' has no meaning in this context.

example_sentence: Tomorrow I will ___ a test on the history lesson.
l1_interference: Os falantes de português costumam traduzir 'fazer uma prova' literalmente como 'make a test' ou 'do a test', mas em inglês o aluno sempre diz 'take a test'.
explanation: In English, 'take' is used with tests, exams, notes, and breaks, meaning to participate in or perform an activity. A student takes a test; a teacher makes one.

related_collocations.example: She will take an exam next week.
Please take notes during the lecture.
I do my homework after dinner.

memory_tip: TAKE = take part in (tests, exams, notes, breaks) | MAKE = create (decisions, plans, choices)
